exclusion_reason: The WebGPU primary backend is implemented: every fixed-function and shader-model 1-3 program lowers through the one WGSL emitter into a complete render-pipeline description with a bind-group layout derived from the program's own registers, a color target with its gamma encoding, and a multisample count, and the pipeline cache is content-addressed and API-blind. The benchmark remains red because rendering each fixture on a live WebGPU adapter does not run in the gate; no adapter is available inside the offline validator.
promotion_trigger: Promote when every declared fixture renders on the live adapter through the primary backend.
expected_failing_assertion: Every declared fixture renders on a live WebGPU adapter within tolerance.
active_gate_evidence: The graphics suite proves every FFP and SM1-3 fixture lowers through the one emitter into a well-formed WebGPU pipeline description carrying the register-derived bind-group layout, gamma-encoded color target, and multisample count, and that the pipeline cache is content-addressed.
procedure: Render each declared fixture through the primary backend on the live adapter.
Compare each frame against the test-time reference within the frozen tolerance.
